contextWindowTokens.note: The report scales the reinforcement-learning context window to 128k.

openWeights.note: The repository holds the report only.

released.note: The repository announces the model on 2025-01-20; the arXiv report followed on 2025-01-22.

lifecycle.note: No current availability statement was found; the model was offered in the Kimi app and on the Kimi platform at release, and no weights were published.

summary.text: Kimi k1.5 is a multimodal reasoning model trained with reinforcement learning, released with a technical report on 2025-01-20. Moonshot AI describes long-context scaling of reinforcement learning and long-to-short methods for its long and short chain-of-thought modes. No weights were published.

openWeights.note: Weights on Hugging Face under the MIT License.

parameters.note: Mixture-of-Experts; 2.8B parameters activated in the language decoder.

summary.text: Kimi-VL is an open-weight vision-language Mixture-of-Experts model with 16B total and 2.8B activated parameters, released on 2025-04-10 as Kimi-VL-A3B-Instruct and Kimi-VL-A3B-Thinking. Moonshot AI describes a MoonViT vision encoder for native-resolution images and a 128K context window.

variants.name: Kimi-VL-A3B-Thinking
variants.note: Long chain-of-thought variant trained with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning.

summary.text: Kimi-Audio is an open-source audio foundation model for audio understanding, generation and conversation, released on 2025-04-25 with Kimi-Audio-7B-Instruct weights and a technical report. Moonshot AI says it was pre-trained on more than 13 million hours of audio and combines continuous acoustic features with discrete semantic tokens.

openWeights.note: Released under the MIT License, subject to the Qwen licence of the base model.

summary.text: Kimi-Dev-72B is an open-weight coding model for software-engineering tasks such as issue resolution, released on 2025-06-16. Moonshot AI built it on Qwen2.5-72B and optimised it with large-scale reinforcement learning on repository patches checked by test suites.

openWeights.note: Code and weights under a Modified MIT License.

milestones.label: Kimi K2 technical report on arXiv

summary.text: Kimi K2 is an open-weight Mixture-of-Experts language model with 1 trillion total and 32 billion activated parameters, released on 2025-07-11 as Kimi-K2-Base and Kimi-K2-Instruct. Moonshot AI describes it as built for agentic tasks such as tool use and coding, pre-trained on 15.5T tokens with the MuonClip optimizer.

variants.name: Kimi-K2-Base
variants.note: The foundation model, for researchers who want to fine-tune.

variants.name: Kimi-K2-Instruct
variants.note: The post-trained model for chat and agentic use, without long thinking.

changes.text: Context window extended from 128K to 256K tokens.
Moonshot AI reports better agentic coding and front-end programming.

relations.note: The card calls it the latest, most capable version of Kimi K2.

summary.text: Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905 is an updated Kimi K2 instruct model released on 2025-09-05. Moonshot AI says it improves agentic coding and front-end programming and extends the context window from 128K to 256K tokens; the architecture of 1 trillion total and 32 billion activated parameters is unchanged.

lifecycle.note: Released as open weights with a research paper; no Kimi app or API offering was found.

summary.text: Kimi Linear is a hybrid linear-attention architecture, released on 2025-10-30 with Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B models of 48B total and 3B activated parameters. Moonshot AI says its Kimi Delta Attention reduces the KV cache by up to 75% and supports a 1M-token context.

changes.text: Adds long step-by-step thinking interleaved with tool calls.
Ships with native INT4 weights from quantisation-aware training.

relations.note: Built on the Kimi K2 architecture (1T total, 32B activated) and trained as a thinking agent.

summary.text: Kimi K2 Thinking is an open-weight thinking-agent version of Kimi K2, released on 2025-11-06. Moonshot AI says it reasons step by step while using tools, keeps working across 200 to 300 sequential tool calls, has a 256K context window and ships with native INT4 quantisation.

inputModalities.note: Video input is described as experimental.

changes.text: Adds native image and video understanding, trained jointly with text.
Adds Agent Swarm, in which the model plans and runs parallel sub-agents.

milestones.label: Kimi K2.5 technical report on arXiv

relations.note: Continued pre-training from Kimi K2 on mixed visual and text tokens.

summary.text: Kimi K2.5 is an open-weight native multimodal agentic model released on 2026-01-27. Moonshot AI built it by continued pre-training of Kimi K2 on about 15 trillion mixed visual and text tokens, and introduced an Agent Swarm mode in which the model coordinates sub-agents in parallel.

inputModalities.note: Video input is described as experimental and only available through the official API.

changes.text: Agent Swarm scales to 300 sub-agents and 4,000 coordinated steps, up from 100 and 1,500.

relations.note: Agent Swarm grows from 100 sub-agents and 1,500 steps in K2.5 to 300 and 4,000.

summary.text: Kimi K2.6 is an open-weight native multimodal agentic model released on 2026-04-20, with 1 trillion total and 32 billion activated parameters. Moonshot AI positions it for long-horizon coding and says its Agent Swarm scales to 300 sub-agents and 4,000 coordinated steps.

news.title: Hugging Face bans first uncensored models, Kimi K2.7 Code vanishes

relations.note: Described as a coding-specialised version of Kimi K2.6.

summary.text: Kimi K2.7 Code is an open-weight coding model released on 2026-06-12, a coding-specialised version of Kimi K2.6 with 1 trillion total and 32 billion activated parameters and a 256K context window. It is offered through the Kimi API and the Kimi Code CLI; Moonshot AI reports fewer reasoning tokens than K2.6.

openWeights.note: Code and weights under the custom Kimi K3 License.

parameters.note: Mixture-of-Experts with 104B activated parameters, per the model card.

changes.text: New architecture combining Kimi Delta Attention with Attention Residuals.
Grows from 1T to 2.8T total parameters, with 104B activated.
Context window grows to 1 million tokens.
Weights under a new custom Kimi K3 License instead of a Modified MIT License.

milestones.label: Kimi K3 weights and technical report released

relations.note: The next flagship generation after the K2 line.

summary.text: Kimi K3 is a 2.8-trillion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with native vision and a 1-million-token context window, launched on 2026-07-16 in Kimi and the Kimi API, with weights following on 2026-07-27. Moonshot AI says it is built on a new architecture of Kimi Delta Attention and Attention Residuals.

parameters.note: Mixture-of-Experts with 104B activated parameters, as for Kimi K3.

changes.text: More post-training compute, with large-scale joint reinforcement learning across many domains.
Cyber-related training data removed to limit offensive cyber capability of the open weights.

released.note: Announced on 2026-10-23 (US time), already 2026-10-24 in China; some reports use the later date.

summary.text: Kimi K3.1 Pro is a post-trained version of Kimi K3, released on 2026-10-23 in Kimi.ai, Kimi Work, Kimi Code and the Kimi API together with a faster Highspeed variant. It keeps the 1M-token context window; Moonshot AI says it removed cyber-related training data and promised full weights by 2026-11-04.

variants.note: Moonshot AI says it runs 2 to 3 times faster.

description.text: Moonshot AI (月之暗面) is an AI company based in Beijing, China, founded in 2023 by Yang Zhilin, Zhou Xinyu and Wu Yuxin. It develops the Kimi assistant, offered on the web, in apps and through the Kimi API, and the Kimi models, many of which it releases with open weights on Hugging Face.
